name: Daisy Completion Defect
definition: For $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$ and a root $r$, let $D_r(C)=\bigcup_{c\in C}[r,c]$ in the ambient cube. Then $\delta_D(C)=\min_r(|D_r(C)|-|C|)$, the fewest concepts that must be added on the same coordinates to obtain a daisy cube.
normalization: The minimum ranges over every ambient cube vertex, whether or not it belongs to $C$.
comments: It is nonincreasing under nonempty pc-minors and vanishes exactly on daisy cubes.
